freshness_note: last_confirmed_at is the date we could last see the row on the provider's own page. It is not the date the provider updated anything, and it is not a guarantee that the row is there right now. listed=gone means the row was there and is not any more, declared only after two consecutive successful readings missed it and dated (delisted_at) from the first reading that missed it. listed=unknown means the record predates this presence log; we do not guess a date.
